subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR keep runtime legacy no-code missing-source invalidation as the upgrade path, or should that cleanup move to doctor/state migration before merge?
rationale: The explicit marker follows prior feedback, but the legacy no-code branch is compatibility-sensitive persisted-state behavior and prior review explicitly rejected broad no-pluginId invalidation.

options.title: Keep Runtime Legacy Invalidation
options.body: Accept the narrow no-pluginId/no-code/missing-absolute-source branch after the contributor supplies redacted latest-head upgrade proof.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Require the legacy no-code row cleanup to run through doctor or state migration while keeping only explicit-code invalidation in runtime.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Allow merge based on source inspection and tests, intentionally waiving the external real-behavior proof gap for upgraded SQLite state.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime Legacy Invalidation
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow no-pluginId/no-code/missing-absolute-source branch after the contributor supplies redacted latest-head upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They gave the predecessor's explicit-marker direction and have the clearest recent review context for this compatibility choice.
